name: append.XMLNode
title: Record nodes are appended after varNames on a simple dataset tree.

origin.description: This appends one or more XML nodes as children of an existing node.
origin.details: A list from lapply is unwrapped when its first element is not an XMLNode.
origin.value: The original to node containing its new children nodes.

translation.description: This appends one or more XML nodes as children of an existing node.
translation.details: A list from lapply is unwrapped when its first element is not an XMLNode.
translation.value: The original to node containing its new children nodes.
translation.example: from XML import newXMLDoc, newXMLNode, saveXML from XML.append_XMLNode import append_XMLNode txt = 'helloworld!' ns = 'z' html = 'Higo' doc = newXMLDoc() n = newXMLNode('data', attrs={'numVars': '2', 'numRecords': '3'}, doc=doc) append_XMLNode(n, newXMLNode('varNames', newXMLNode('string', 'A', doc=doc), newXMLNode('string', 'B', doc=doc), doc=doc)) append_XMLNode(n, newXMLNode('record', '1.2 3.5', doc=doc)) append_XMLNode(n, newXMLNode('record', '20.2 13.9', doc=doc)) append_XMLNode(n, newXMLNode('record', '10.1 5.67', doc=doc)) print(saveXML(n))
